signature: SUBROUTINE DTPLQT( M, N, L, MB, A, LDA, B, LDB, T, LDT, WORK,

params.name: M
params.reference: The number of rows of the matrix B, and the order of the triangular matrix A. $M \ge 0$.

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of columns of the matrix B. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: L
params.reference: The number of rows of the lower trapezoidal part of B. $\min (M,N) \ge L \ge 0$. See Further Details.

params.name: mb
params.reference: The block size to be used in the blocked QR. $M \ge \mathrm{MB} \ge 1$.

params.name: A
params.reference: On entry, the lower triangular M-by-M matrix A. On exit, the elements on and below the diagonal of the array contain the lower triangular matrix L.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,M)$.

params.name: B
params.reference: On entry, the pentagonal M-by-N matrix B. The first N-L columns are rectangular, and the last L columns are lower trapezoidal. On exit, B contains the pentagonal matrix V. See Further Details.

params.name: ldb
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array B. $\mathrm{LDB} \ge \max (1,M)$.

params.name: T
params.reference: The lower triangular block reflectors stored in compact form as a sequence of upper triangular blocks. See Further Details.

params.name: ldt
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array T. $\mathrm{LDT} \ge \mathrm{MB}$.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value

checks.js: L < 0 || (L > min( M, N ) && min( M, N ) >= 0)
